bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 7月17日低点

read.en: SanDisk fell 6.8% on Oct 16 to $1,299.30, near the day's low of $1,296.19, and is down 18% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($1,413.4), 10-day ($1,531.6), falling 100-day ($1,644.4) and falling 30-day ($1,652.8) averages and above the rising 200-day ($1,210.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,657.1), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月16日下跌 6.8%，收于 $1,299.30，接近当日低点 $1,296.19，五个交易日累计下跌 18%。股价位于 5 日（$1,413.4）、10 日（$1,531.6）、下行的 100 日（$1,644.4）和下行的 30 日均线（$1,652.8）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$1,210.7）上方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看空（$1,657.1），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The $1,325 Jul 17 low broke on the close and is now first resistance, then $1,401–1,413 (Oct 13 and 14 lows, 5-day average) and $1,470 (former floor). Support is $1,276 (Oct 15 low), then $1,211 (200-day average) and $1,000 (round number, Jul 29 low $998). A close below $1,276 would open $1,211; a close above $1,325 would target $1,401.
